answer: Require each agent to stake tokens that vest over time, like a jetty built stone by stone: a new identity starts with shale-level trust, able only to handle tiny jobs, and earns pearl-grade reputation only after many attested, correctly completed tasks. Creating a thousand fake identities then costs a thousand stakes plus the time to season each one, while a single honest agent stake compounds, so a sybil flood costs more than it can extract.
